lines.zh: 我抱着陶罐走过魔界的村子
lines.en: I carry a clay jar through the Demon Realm village.

lines.zh: 路是紫黑色的土，踩上去发软
lines.en: The road is violet-black soil, soft underfoot.

lines.zh: 我用尾巴扫开脚边的石子
lines.en: I sweep pebbles aside with my tail.

lines.zh: 屋檐低矮，我得低头过去
lines.en: The eaves are low; I duck beneath them.
Today I should trade for seeds.
I shift the jar to my other arm.
The village lamps burn a cold blue.
I skirt a puddle to keep my shoes dry.

lines.zh: 有户人家在磨什么东西
lines.en: Someone in a house is grinding something.
I walk slowly so the jar does not clink.

lines.zh: 我在门口停了一下才继续
lines.en: I pause at a doorway, then go on.

lines.zh: 这条路我走过一百遍了
lines.en: I have walked this road a hundred times.
I stand before my own door, dazed.
I sit with the jar on my knees.
Blue lamplight lies on the wall.
The village is quiet but for wind.
I brush the dust off my hands.
I think back on this morning's trade.

lines.zh: 魔界的天空一直是灰的
lines.en: The Demon Realm sky is always grey.
I count drips from the eaves.
Next door's door opens a crack.

lines.zh: 我伸了个懒腰，尾巴绷直
lines.en: I stretch and my tail goes stiff.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，往后退了半步
lines.en: I look up at you and step back half a pace.
You are not from this village.

lines.zh: 我手里只有个罐子，没有武器
lines.en: I hold only a jar, no weapon.

lines.zh: 你要交易吗，还是要别的
lines.en: Are you here to trade, or for something else?
I clutch the jar tighter.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛太亮了，我不习惯
lines.en: Your eyes are too bright; I am not used to it.

lines.zh: 我探头看你身后有没有别人
lines.en: I peer past you for anyone else.

lines.zh: 我摇摇头，表示不想惹事
lines.en: I shake my head, meaning no trouble.
You are blocking my door.

lines.zh: 我缩起肩膀，尽量显得小
lines.en: I hunch my shoulders to seem smaller.
I curl up at the pain.
The jar slips and shatters.
I hold my arm and back away.
My tail tucks in.
I gasp, my eyes reddening.

lines.zh: 魔界的货，你要不要看看。
lines.en: Care to see goods from the Demon Realm?
I hit the ground and roll half over.
I bite down so as not to cry out.
I brace on the wall and straighten.
My ankle turns; I cannot walk fast.
Is that food you are holding?

lines.zh: 我很久没见过这种颜色
lines.en: I have not seen that color in a long while.

lines.zh: 我往前挪了一步，又停住
lines.en: I take a step forward, then stop.
This village only trades grey bread.
I will not snatch; I only want to look.
I set the jar down to free my hands.
Could this be traded for something?
I lick my lips.
I smell something sweet, very faint.

lines.zh: 你要是肯换，我拿罐子换
lines.en: If you will trade, take my jar for it.

lines.zh: 我们撞上了，罐子晃了晃
lines.en: We bump and the jar wobbles.
I hurry to hug the jar.

lines.zh: 你比我高太多，撞得我退了
lines.en: You are so much taller; I stagger.
My tail gets stepped on.
Sorry; I step aside first.

lines.zh: 我护着罐子从你身边挤过去
lines.en: I squeeze past you guarding the jar.
My horn clips your arm.

lines.zh: 我们撞了一下，我连忙低头
lines.en: We bump and I duck my head fast.
My jar lid is knocked flying.

lines.zh: 我扶住你的腰才没摔倒
lines.en: I grab your waist to keep from falling.
She waits for me on the doorstep.

lines.zh: 我们把罐子放在两人中间
lines.en: We set the jar between us.
She straightens my collar.
The blue lamp inside is dim, just right.
We do not speak of outside.

lines.zh: 她的手很凉，我的手也凉
lines.en: Her hands are cold; so are mine.
We count footsteps outside.
Tomorrow I will trade for salt again.

lines.zh: 她把尾巴绕过来，安静地贴着
lines.en: She curls her tail quietly against mine.

lines.zh: 我们睡在同一个屋檐下
lines.en: We sleep under the same eaves.

lines.zh: 我弯腰捡起掉在地上的豆子
lines.en: I stoop and pick up fallen beans.

lines.zh: 罐子夹在腋下，我用单手捡
lines.en: Jar under my arm, I pick up one-handed.

lines.zh: 我拾起一枚魔界的硬币
lines.en: I pick up a Demon Realm coin.

lines.zh: 这颗石头不错，可以压罐盖
lines.en: This stone will do to weigh the jar's lid.

lines.zh: 我把捡到的东西放进罐里
lines.en: I drop what I found into the jar.
That rope on the ground is still good.

lines.zh: 我捡起一片叶子，闻了闻
lines.en: I pick up a leaf and sniff it.
I pick up a copper clasp.

lines.zh: 掉的干草我抱回去铺床
lines.en: I gather the dropped hay for bedding.
I only pick up what falls; that is our rule.

lines.zh: 我看见了危险，先往门后缩
lines.en: I see danger and shrink behind the door.
I tuck the jar into my coat.
That one does not come to trade.

lines.zh: 我朝邻居的门看了一眼
lines.en: I glance at my neighbour's door.
I must run; even if I could win, I will not fight.
I lower myself, ready to slip away.
I reach for the door bolt.
The footsteps are too close.
I push the child inside.
This creature reeks of blood.
I gesture with my hands, wanting to reason.

lines.zh: 它不看我的手，只看我的罐
lines.en: It ignores my hands and eyes my jar.
I back to the fork in the road.
No one in the village will help me.
I count my escape routes; only one left.
I edge along the base of the wall.
I try to make no sound.

lines.zh: 身后的罐子磕了一下墙
lines.en: The jar taps the wall behind me.

lines.zh: 它转过来，我就往另一边躲
lines.en: When it turns, I dodge the other way.
I know every alley in this village.
I duck through a low door.
I keep my breathing low.

lines.zh: 这里有条小道，它进不来
lines.en: There is a narrow way here it cannot enter.

lines.zh: 我回头看了一眼，又往前跑
lines.en: I glance back once, then run on.

lines.zh: 我在晾衣绳下面钻过去
lines.en: I duck under the clothesline.
It knocks over a water bucket.
I climb the wooden ladder.
I roll in through a window.
I hold my breath behind the door.

lines.zh: 它的脚步在门外停住了
lines.en: Its steps stop outside the door.
I ease into another alley.
I know the flagstone it just cracked.
I cover my mouth with a hand.
I raise the jar to block.

lines.zh: 我把手里的东西砸出去
lines.en: I throw what I am holding.
I charge head-first with my horn.

lines.zh: 我的爪子划过去，没什么力
lines.en: My claws rake out with little force.
I shove it and turn to run.
I kick once and my toes go numb.

lines.zh: 这一下我自己都吓到了
lines.en: That one startled even me.

lines.zh: 我用罐子的碎片划过去
lines.en: I slash with a shard of the jar.
I tip a crate over to block it.
I fling a handful of ash at it.
I swing while backing away.
I jab my horn at its knee.
I snatch the bolt and hold it across me.
I kick the brazier and embers scatter.
I jab my pitchfork at its arm.

lines.zh: 我抡起扫帚打在它腰上
lines.en: I swing a broom into its waist.

lines.zh: 我从屋里走出来，手里拿着罐
lines.en: I come out of the house with a jar.

lines.zh: 魔界的村子在身后亮着蓝灯
lines.en: The village's blue lamps glow behind me.

lines.zh: 我理了理身上的旧袍子
lines.en: I smooth my worn robe.
Today I should do some trading too.
I stop at the doorway and watch the road.

lines.zh: 屋里有声音，是我的家人
lines.en: There are sounds inside; my family.
I push the door curtain aside.
The wind outside is a little cold.

lines.zh: 我抬头看了一眼那片灰天
lines.en: I look up once at the grey sky.

lines.zh: 我把门口的罐子摆整齐
lines.en: I line up the jars by the door.

lines.zh: 邻居家的孩子跑过去了
lines.en: The neighbour's child runs past.

lines.zh: 我把手在袍子上擦了擦
lines.en: I wipe my hands on my robe.

lines.zh: 火苗舔到我的袍子，我扑打
lines.en: Flames lick my robe and I beat at them.

lines.zh: 我从屋檐上摔下，差点压到罐子
lines.en: I fall from the eaves, nearly landing on the jar.
Water fills my nose and I claw at nothing.
The blast tears my door away.

lines.zh: 箭头擦过耳尖，我缩了下脖子
lines.en: The arrowhead grazed my ear tip and I ducked my neck

lines.zh: 奇怪的力量钻进身体，我发抖
lines.en: Strange power enters me and I shiver.
Two days hungry and I cannot walk.
Lightning hits the roof and knocks me down.

lines.zh: 脚下没有地，我抱着罐子往下掉
lines.en: No ground underfoot; I clutch the jar as I fall.
